summary: Share Card (final pre-launch feature) verified end-to-end. Backend: 55/55 pytest pass (52 prior regression + 3 new TestShareCard: auto-creates player on first GET with all 10 required keys & correct defaults [coins=100, gems=5, stars=0, levels_completed=0, raids_won=0, wall_level=1, homestead_level=1, homestead_xp=0, character_id='chris', name='Adventurer'], reflects updated stats after /progress + /defense/raid/resolve [name/character_id/levels/stars/raids/coins all update], no MongoDB _id leakage). Frontend: MainMenu now renders exactly 10 CTAs (start-game, open-map, open-endless, open-tetris, open-daily, open-homestead, open-defense, open-share, open-leaderboard, open-achievements — all visible). /share route loads, share-card-page + share-card-content render, 6 stat tiles show server data ('Coins 100', 'Gems 5', 'Stars 0', 'Levels 0/6', 'Farm Lv 1', 'Raids 0'), 3 action buttons + back-to-menu visible, share-name='Adventurer', tagline pill 'Rising Stray' rendered with class 'bg-slate-900 text-amber-300' (black pill + amber text per spec). Copy Tweet writes multi-line text starting with character role + emoji stats + URL to navigator.clipboard. Download PNG triggers html2canvas → anchor.click with download='strayz-adventurer.png' and href='data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0K…' (valid PNG) + toast 'Share card downloaded!'. back-to-menu returns to MainMenu. Regression: /homestead, /defense, /map, /daily, /leaderboard all load with zero error overlays. Only console noise = benign AudioContext autoplay warning.
critical_code_review_comments: share-card endpoint correctly excludes mongo _id via projection {_id:0} and auto-creates default PlayerProgress when missing — idempotent and safe.
Tagline ordering in ShareCard.jsx matches spec precedence (levels>=6 → raids>=5 → homestead>=3 → levels>=3 → coins>=500 → fallback). Tagline pill uses bg-slate-900 + text-amber-300 as required.
shareText template includes character role/name, stats with emoji, and window.location.origin — all present in actual clipboard capture.
html2canvas invoked with backgroundColor:null, scale:2, useCORS:true; portrait img has crossOrigin='anonymous' — good for capturing remote portraits without taint.
Native share falls back to copyShareText when navigator.share is undefined — graceful degradation verified.
10 CTAs in MainMenu confirmed visible; Share Card uses pink color and navigates to /share via React Router (no full reload).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 10 MainMenu CTAs + all share-card testids + 3 action buttons + back-to-menu + clipboard + download flow verified; 5 regression routes load cleanly
